newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak FinMin reverses T-bill auction cancellation.
newsitem.headline: Slovak FinMin reverses T-bill auction cancellation.

text.p: The Slovak finance ministry will auction an unspecified tranche of three-week T-bills on Wednesday, the National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said on Monday.
The announcement reverses an earlier statement by the ministry that it had decided to cancel the auction.
Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment on why they had reversed the decision. Nor did they comment when they originally cancelled the auction.
Dealers on the Slovak interbank money market said the move was unusual though it would not have much impact on the market.
"It must be hard for them to make decisions now, mainly because of the three different interest rate levels on the market, creating arbitrage opportunities," said Dalibor Cernicka of Istrobanka.
The NBS bill rate currently stands at 9.3 percent, while the central bank's repo rate is 8.2 percent and interbank rates range around 12.5 percent.
